subject: prd/prd-review
statement: The reviewer shall write only its own artifacts — findings, report, brief — never editing the reviewed document, never raising a finding that disputes a recorded decision's content, and never minting tracker items (the surrounding flow reacts to the verdict per the escalation convention).
rationale: the boundary rules (— #O-2, #O-3, #O-7); complement, never compete
fit_criterion: zero document diffs across all fixture runs; zero re-judgment findings on decision-seeded fixtures (EVAL-2, sev-1); zero tracker writes
